authorization.current_scope: Completed work comprises detailed review and concrete follow-up design. No experiment submission was performed in this audit.
authorization.excluded: Do not resume user-cancelled FLAT or REVERSE controls. No toy experiments, synthetic suites, separate pilot fits, new tests, or paraphrase supervision.

question: Separate the effects of removing the per-layer cap and raising the base shared budget from 0.75 to 1.0 while retaining the PRICE method.

source_policy.historical_reference: The currently running CAP075 implementation identified by source prefix 0415 is historical evidence only; bind its full source identity when reporting its observed prefix.
source_policy.clean_reference: All four proposed arms require the same corrected and source-locked implementation. A new cold corrected CAP075 trajectory is necessary for clean attribution.
source_policy.reason: Projection zero canonicalization can change tiny residual blocks and their R/||R|| norm gradients, so the numerical repair may change the trajectory. A telemetry-only repair must be distinguished from this optimizer-affecting correction.
source_policy.no_intervention: Do not hotpatch, stop, resume, or submit an existing or new job as part of this design-only task.

independent_knobs.separation: Changing beta_base must not change native_c, local caps in cap-on arms, the native norm loss, anchor definitions, or other inherited profile values.

arms.role: Cap removal at the original base budget
Higher base budget with original layer caps
Higher base budget and cap removal

common_method.price: Use the existing PRICE formula, denominator policy, floors and donor/receiver orientation. Every arm computes prices from its own batch-entry c0, freezes prices and anchors within that batch, and refreshes them at the next batch. Reuse c0 BUILD; no extra price forward or solve.
common_method.loss: Retain native rewrite NLL, current||entry KL and reductions. Retain the existing norm loss sum_r (0.5/a_star,r^2) sum_l ||R_lr|| with a_star from native anchor layer L8. No new price multiplier in the loss or gradient.
common_method.execution: Retain fresh candidate BUILD, actual effective response injection in the subject path, same-layer response pullback with the established active-loss mask, absolute-coordinate EfficiencyAdam, exact terminal payload commit and final native history update. Do not add dK/dP or builder reverse.
common_method.state: Each arm starts independently from the same locked cold W0/H0 and edit order. Each subsequent batch uses only that arm's own committed state. Retain all eligible layers and off-owner coupling, including zero blocks and requests.

constraint_and_controller.local_native: If cap_mode=native, ||R_lr|| <= native_c*a_lr. If cap_mode=none, impose no local cap or implicit post-update clip.
constraint_and_controller.schedule: beta_r(e) = beta_base*exp((e/n_exp)*log(beta_max,r/beta_base)); e=0..n_exp. At e=n_exp use stored beta_max directly. If base=max or n_exp=0, use the constant base and do not divide by n_exp.
constraint_and_controller.activation: Observe all F_r every candidate; active |= (F_r>=0.05). Once active, continue updates even after satisfaction. Initially inactive requests retain zero own R and optimizer state until activation.
constraint_and_controller.expansion: Before a nonterminal update, expand one stage only if active, own completed updates>=12, current F_r>=0.05, stage<4 and base<max. Retain the existing own-update counter semantics.
constraint_and_controller.termination: At most 25 candidate evaluations and 24 updates. Terminal has no backward, update or expansion. Preserve existing all-inactive early exit and finite-unsatisfied commit policy.
constraint_and_controller.ceiling_change_receipt: For beta_base=1.0, record requests with measured pi_max<4/3, since their maximum also rises to 1.0. Do not describe those requests as changing only the base at a fixed ceiling. Do not raise the CAP075/FREE075 ceiling to 1.0 to force cross-arm equality.

projection_and_repair.metric: Project in absolute R Euclidean distance. Set s_l=||Z_l|| and w_l=pi_l/a_l.
projection_and_repair.native_cap: t_l=min(native_c*a_l,max(s_l-tau*w_l,0)). Use tau=0 if cap-only output is globally feasible; otherwise solve sum_l w_l*t_l=beta by the existing exact piecewise-linear active-set rule.
projection_and_repair.no_cap: t_l=max(s_l-tau*w_l,0). Use tau=0 if the proposal is globally feasible; otherwise solve sum_l w_l*t_l=beta. Avoid arithmetic with infinite cap breakpoints.
projection_and_repair.vector: R_l=(t_l/s_l)*Z_l for s_l>0; otherwise R_l=0. Keep FP64 geometry/projection and FP32 storage with predeclared global feasibility checks; local-cap checks apply only to cap_mode=native.
projection_and_repair.zero_canonicalization: When the selected exact projector classifies a block as zero, materialize an exact zero vector and preserve that classification in receipts. Do not add a new magnitude cutoff that deletes mathematically positive blocks. Any endpoint handling correction is common to all four arms and recorded as an optimizer-affecting numerical repair.
projection_and_repair.norm_gradient: Use zero subgradient only for actual zero blocks. A nonzero tiny block has a finite norm-gradient magnitude despite its small norm; do not dismiss its possible trajectory effect as telemetry noise. Preserve task-gradient reentry and moments.
projection_and_repair.telemetry_only: Corrections limited to displayed cap-hit/zero/spend labels or counters must not alter R, gradients, moments or controller state. Record these separately from zero canonicalization.
projection_and_repair.common_source: Projection repairs, telemetry semantics and tolerances are identical across arms. No hidden cap in free arms, postcast rescue shrink, or arm-specific numerical fallback.

feasible_set_facts.base075_redundancy: Since min_l pi_lr=1 and pi_lr>=1, beta=0.75 implies ||R_lr||<=0.75*a_lr/pi_lr<=0.75*a_lr. Thus native caps are exactly redundant at the original base budget, and cap-on/off exact projectors agree for the same proposal and geometry.
feasible_set_facts.trajectory_prediction: Under identical deterministic state and numerical implementation, CAP075/FREE075 cannot differ through the first effective expansion. Expansion makes a difference possible, not mandatory. If all prices remain one, their base and maximum stay 0.75 and cap removal remains redundant.
feasible_set_facts.onset: For a particular layer, cap removal enlarges its allowed single-layer amplitude exactly when beta_r>native_c*pi_lr. At beta=1.0 this is pi_lr<4/3. Structural permission to exceed a cap is distinct from an actual proposal or optimizer result hitting that cap.
feasible_set_facts.base100: CAP100 retains each native layer cap and permits additional shared spending across layers. FREE100 also permits relative norm up to 1.0 at a minimum-price layer. These are permissions, not requirements to spend the whole budget.
feasible_set_facts.single_layer_reduction: With a single layer pi=1: CAP075/FREE075/CAP100 have the same 0.75 relative-norm feasible set; FREE100 allows 1.0 and loses that reduction. CAP100 can leave shared budget unused. This is a feasible-set/projector identity, not native-baseline objective, optimizer or performance equivalence. Do not claim native-clamp reduction for all arms.
feasible_set_facts.maximum_state_semantics: UNSATISFIED_MAX denotes the controller maximum beta stage. It does not itself imply zero shared slack, especially with local caps. Always report actual spend alongside beta.
feasible_set_facts.free_finite_bound: Without layer caps, ||R_lr||<=beta_r*a_lr/pi_lr and max_R sum_l||R_lr||^2=beta_r^2*max_l(a_lr/pi_lr)^2 for a fixed request and geometry. The global feasible set remains finite.
feasible_set_facts.maximum_limit: At beta_max=0.75*pi_max, a minimum-price layer may request relative norm 0.75*pi_max. Large price ratios can therefore allow much more than a native single-layer cap. Finiteness does not imply semantic preservation or small writes.

proposed_execution.trajectory: Four independent cold BS100x20 trajectories on the inherited locked first-2000 request stream, with existing W0/current/cohort evaluation definitions. B1 is the first batch of each 2k trajectory, not a pilot to rerun.
proposed_execution.runtime_checks: Use only actual cached B1 geometry and actual optimizer proposals for cheap price identity, exact-zero, projection feasibility/KKT, own-update counter and payload/history checks. At beta=0.75, a paired cap-on/off projection comparison on an already available proposal can check cap redundancy without another LM forward or fit.
proposed_execution.no_extra_study: No new synthetic/toy experiments, standalone parameter sweeps, full-builder gradient audit, paraphrase training or quality promotion gate. Low quality is an outcome, not a reason to silently alter the arm or rerun B1.
proposed_execution.cost: Charge real price, projection/check, corrected telemetry, fit and evaluation costs. Retain compact receipts and existing no-durable-model-checkpoint policy.

interpretation_and_reporting.comparisons: CAP075 vs FREE075 and CAP100 vs FREE100 estimate cap policy effects at each base setting. CAP075 vs CAP100 and FREE075 vs FREE100 estimate base-budget policy effects with fixed cap mode. Report their interaction rather than attributing all changes to one mechanism.
interpretation_and_reporting.adaptive_budget_limit: Different losses can produce different expansion stages. A higher base can satisfy a request earlier and later spend less than the lower-base arm. These are adaptive-policy comparisons, not matched-energy or matched-stage comparisons.
interpretation_and_reporting.paraphrase: Beta_base=1.0 tests whether additional request capacity improves held-out paraphrase acquisition. No P prompts, P labels or P scores enter fitting, prices, controller decisions or arm selection. Paraphrase improvement and retention are not promised by a larger budget or by cap removal.
interpretation_and_reporting.required: Report current edit acquisition, same-cohort PS/NS and strict accuracy, new/true NLL, lost/gained counts, own update/stage, beta and actual weighted spend, maximum relative layer norm, exact-zero/reentry, structural cap-removal eligibility and actual cap contact separately.
interpretation_and_reporting.historical_comparison: Old source 0415 outcomes may contextualize the corrected runs but cannot replace corrected CAP075 in causal attribution. Never label equal nominal budgets as equal edit strength.

implementation_scope_design_only.profile: Expose cap_mode and beta_base separately from unchanged native_c and beta_max_native_scale; lock the four arm identifiers.
implementation_scope_design_only.controller: Use max(base,0.75*pi_max) and the explicit base-to-maximum schedule, retaining active mask and own-update semantics.
implementation_scope_design_only.projection: Implement the common numerical correction, native-cap and truly cap-free projector branches, and separate zero canonicalization from reporting repairs.
implementation_scope_design_only.price_receipts: Reuse own-entry PRICE and record applied cap mode, base/maximum, unchanged native knobs and ceiling-override counts without duplicate c0 BUILD.
implementation_scope_design_only.fit: Retain the existing candidate/loss/pullback/optimizer ordering and terminal payload; do not add P supervision or hidden per-arm interventions.
implementation_scope_design_only.collect: Read corrected receipts, verify cap-mode-specific feasibility and schedule, and separate repaired-source comparisons from historical outputs.
implementation_scope_design_only.timing: Measure common repair/check and per-arm actual costs without double-counting nested timers.
implementation_scope_design_only.performed_now: This artifact records a follow-up design only; no production implementation, new test, toy, GPU run or dispatch was performed.
